name: M3_PPS100MI_LstAgrHead
description: List purchase agreement headers for a company. Each returned record represents one agreement header and includes key information such as supplier, agreement number and type, validity dates, status, and a short description. The data also contains the supplier’s own agreement number, facility, object access group, and purchase organization, which indicate where and by whom the agreement can be used. Use this operation to get an overview of existing purchase agreements at header level; agreement lines and staggered prices are handled by other list and retrieve operations in the purchase agreement interface.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which agreement headers are listed.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number identifying the supplier for the purchase agreement header.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number identifying the purchase agreement.

outputParameters.name: AGTP
outputParameters.description: Agreement type defining the category and behavior of the purchase agreement.

outputParameters.name: FVDT
outputParameters.description: Date from which the agreement is valid.

outputParameters.name: UVDT
outputParameters.description: Date until which the agreement is valid.

outputParameters.name: PAST
outputParameters.description: Current status of the supplier agreement, such as preliminary, valid, completed, or cancelled.

outputParameters.name: TX30
outputParameters.description: Short description or comment for the agreement header.

outputParameters.name: VAGN
outputParameters.description: Supplier's own agreement number referencing this purchase agreement.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for or associated with the purchase agreement.

outputParameters.name: ACGR
outputParameters.description: Object access group used to control which users may access this agreement.

outputParameters.name: PORG
outputParameters.description: Purchase organization that defines which warehouses and planning entities may use this agreement.
